source: Written 2026-10-14 from the verified oracle text (Scryfall, fetched 2026-10-14) and this deck's notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named.

scenes.head: The Ur-Dragon — Dragon tribal ramp
scenes.sub: Five colors, 28 Dragons in the 99, and a commander that works before you ever cast it.
scenes.say: The Ur-Dragon. Dragon tribal ramp in five colors, with twenty-eight Dragons in the ninety-nine, and a commander that works before you ever cast it.

scenes.head: Eminence: it works from the command zone
scenes.sub: As long as The Ur-Dragon is in the command zone or on the battlefield, other Dragon spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
scenes.say: Eminence. As long as The Ur-Dragon is in the command zone or on the battlefield, your other Dragon spells cost one less. From turn one.

scenes.head: Then it attacks
scenes.sub: Whenever one or more Dragons you control attack, draw that many cards, then you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.

scenes.head: Three Dragons attack: draw three
scenes.sub: Then drop the best permanent in your hand, here [[Atarka, World Render]], straight onto the battlefield.

scenes.head: Make them cheap. Attack for cards. Win.
scenes.sub: Four clips follow: the discounts, the attack engine, damage that draws cards, and how the deck wins.

scenes.head: Stack the discounts
scenes.sub: Eminence: {1} less on every other Dragon spell. [[Dragonspeaker Shaman]]: {2} less. [[Sarkhan, Soul Aflame]]: {1} less. All three: four less.
scenes.say: Stack the discounts. Eminence takes one off every other Dragon spell. [[Dragonspeaker Shaman]] takes two. [[Sarkhan, Soul Aflame]] takes one more. With all three, a Dragon costs four less.

scenes.head: Generic mana only
scenes.sub: A discount never pays a colored pip. With all three out, [[Lathliss, Dragon Queen|Lathliss]] ({4}{R}{R}) costs just {R}{R}.
scenes.say: Discounts only cut generic mana, never the colored pips. Lathliss costs four generic and two red. With all three discounts out, it costs just the two red.

scenes.head: Ramp into five colors
scenes.sub: Two mana dorks, four land searches, and rocks that tap for any color.

scenes.head: A fast start
scenes.sub: Turn 1: [[Forest]], then [[Birds of Paradise]].
scenes.say: A fast start. Turn one: a [[Forest]], then [[Birds of Paradise]].

scenes.head: Turn 2: Dragonspeaker Shaman
scenes.sub: Play a [[Mountain]]. Forest, Mountain and Birds make {G}{R}{R}, and the Shaman costs {1}{R}{R}.
scenes.say: Turn two: play a Mountain. The Forest, the Mountain and the Birds make one green and two red. That pays for [[Dragonspeaker Shaman]].

scenes.head: Turn 3: Ganax for two mana
scenes.sub: [[Rootbound Crag]] enters untapped: you control a Mountain. [[Ganax, Astral Hunter|Ganax]] ({4}{R}) loses three, so Forest and Mountain pay {1}{R}.
scenes.say: Turn three. [[Rootbound Crag]] enters untapped, because you control a Mountain. Ganax costs five, minus one from eminence and two from the Shaman. The Forest and the Mountain pay the two that's left.

scenes.head: Ganax makes a Treasure
scenes.sub: Whenever Ganax or another Dragon you control enters, create a Treasure token.

scenes.head: Then Lathliss for three
scenes.sub: [[Lathliss, Dragon Queen|Lathliss]] ({4}{R}{R}) loses three too: {1}{R}{R}. Tap the Crag and Birds for red, and sacrifice the Treasure.
scenes.say: Then Lathliss. It loses three too, so it costs three: tap the Crag and the Birds for red, and sacrifice the Treasure for the last one.

scenes.head: Two Dragons on turn three
scenes.sub: Lathliss is a Dragon entering, so Ganax makes another Treasure to keep.

scenes.head: And it snowballs
scenes.sub: Each nontoken Dragon after this brings a 5/5 flying Dragon token from Lathliss, and Ganax makes a Treasure for every Dragon that enters, tokens included.
scenes.say: And it snowballs. Each nontoken Dragon after this brings a five-five flying Dragon token from Lathliss, and Ganax makes a Treasure for every Dragon that enters, tokens included.

scenes.head: Set the table
scenes.sub: [[Samut, Hazoret's Champion|Samut]]: creatures you control have haste. [[Roaming Throne]] entered naming Dragon. [[Scalelord Reckoner]] is already out.
scenes.say: Set the table. Samut gives the creatures you control haste. [[Roaming Throne]] entered naming Dragon. [[Scalelord Reckoner]] is already out, and The Ur-Dragon waits in the command zone.

scenes.head: Roaming Throne doubles Dragon triggers
scenes.sub: If a triggered ability of another creature you control of the chosen type triggers, it triggers an additional time.

scenes.head: Cast Hellkite Courser
scenes.sub: [[Hellkite Courser]] costs {4}{R}{R}. Eminence works from the command zone, so pay {3}{R}{R}.
scenes.say: Cast [[Hellkite Courser]]. It costs six, and eminence works from the command zone, so you pay five.

scenes.head: Courser brings the commander
scenes.sub: When it enters, put [[The Ur-Dragon]] from the command zone onto the battlefield. It gains haste, and goes back at the beginning of the next end step.

scenes.head: Attack with three Dragons
scenes.sub: Samut gives Courser haste; Courser gave The Ur-Dragon haste. [[Scalelord Reckoner|Reckoner]] joins in.

scenes.head: Three Dragons attacked: draw three
scenes.sub: Then you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield: [[Atarka, World Render]].

scenes.head: Roaming Throne: it triggers again
scenes.sub: Draw three more, then drop a second permanent: [[Dragonlord Dromoka]]. Six cards and two free permanents from one attack.

scenes.head: Then do it twice
scenes.sub: [[Scourge of the Throne]]: the first time each turn it attacks the player with the most life (or tied), untap all attackers. An extra combat follows.
scenes.say: Then do it twice. The first time each turn [[Scourge of the Throne]] attacks the player with the most life, or tied for the most, untap all attacking creatures. An extra combat follows, and that's another Ur-Dragon trigger.

scenes.head: Haste turns new Dragons into attackers
scenes.sub: [[Samut, Hazoret's Champion|Samut]] and [[Temur Ascendancy]] give your creatures haste. [[Rhythm of the Wild]], [[Dragon Tempest]] and [[Lightning Greaves]] can give it too.

scenes.head: [[Niv-Mizzet, Visionary]]
scenes.sub: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, you draw that many cards. You also have no maximum hand size.

scenes.head: Fuel one: Lozhan
scenes.sub: [[Lozhan, Dragons' Legacy|Lozhan]]: whenever you cast an Adventure or Dragon spell, it deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to any target that isn't a commander.

scenes.head: Fuel two: [[Dragon Tempest]]
scenes.sub: Whenever a Dragon you control enters, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of Dragons you control.

scenes.head: Cast Lathliss
scenes.sub: Eminence makes [[Lathliss, Dragon Queen|Lathliss]] cost five, but a discount doesn't change mana value: it's still a 6.
scenes.say: Cast Lathliss. Eminence makes it cost five, but a discount doesn't change its mana value. It's still a six.

scenes.head: Lozhan: six to the face
scenes.sub: Its cast trigger resolves first: 6 damage to an opponent, and Niv-Mizzet draws you six cards.
scenes.say: Lozhan, six to the face. Its cast trigger resolves first: six damage to an opponent, and Niv-Mizzet draws you six cards.

scenes.head: Lathliss enters: Tempest fires
scenes.sub: You control three Dragons (Niv-Mizzet, Lozhan and Lathliss), so it deals 3 to that opponent. Draw three more.
scenes.say: Lathliss enters, and Tempest fires. You control three Dragons: Niv-Mizzet, Lozhan and Lathliss. So it deals three to that opponent. Draw three more.

scenes.head: Nine cards from one spell
scenes.sub: Tempest's other trigger gives a flier haste as it enters, so Lathliss can attack this turn.

scenes.head: More fuel
scenes.sub: [[Scourge of Valkas]] carries Tempest's damage trigger on a body. [[Boros Charm]] deals 4 to a player: draw four. Aim at faces: Niv only counts damage to opponents.
scenes.say: More fuel. [[Scourge of Valkas]] carries Tempest's damage trigger on a body. [[Boros Charm]] deals four to a player: draw four. Aim at faces, because Niv-Mizzet only counts damage to opponents.

scenes.head: Tiamat: cast it, don't cheat it
scenes.sub: When [[Tiamat]] enters, if you cast it, search your library for up to five Dragons with different names and put them into your hand.
scenes.say: Tiamat. Cast it, don't cheat it in. Eminence takes one off, so it costs six. When it enters, if you cast it, search your library for up to five Dragons with different names, and put them into your hand.

scenes.head: Five Dragons to hand
scenes.sub: Take what ends the game this turn, or what rebuilds after a wipe.

scenes.head: It has to be cast
scenes.sub: Put onto the battlefield by [[The Ur-Dragon]]'s attack or by [[Ureni of the Unwritten]], Tiamat searches for nothing.

scenes.head: Clear the way: [[Crux of Fate]]
scenes.sub: Choose “destroy all non-Dragon creatures.” Every non-Dragon dies, yours included. Your Dragons stay.

scenes.head: [[Call the Spirit Dragons]]
scenes.sub: Dragons you control have indestructible. At the beginning of your upkeep, for each color, put a +1/+1 counter on a Dragon you control of that color.

scenes.head: Five Dragons, five colors: you win
scenes.sub: White [[Scalelord Reckoner|Reckoner]], blue [[Marang River Regent // Coil and Catch|Marang River Regent]], black [[Brainstealer Dragon|Brainstealer]], red [[Lathliss, Dragon Queen|Lathliss]], green [[Dragonlord Dromoka|Dromoka]]. Counters on five Dragons win the game.

cards.name: Marang River Regent // Coil and Catch

scenes.head: Or win in the air
scenes.sub: [[Atarka, World Render|Atarka]]: each Dragon that attacks gains double strike. [[Scourge of the Throne]] adds a second combat. With The Ur-Dragon out, each combat draws again.

scenes.head: The Ur-Dragon
scenes.sub: Bracket 3 · 28 Dragons · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: The Ur-Dragon. Bracket three, with twenty-eight Dragons. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
